key_sections.name: Meet Your Host
key_sections.bio: Performance marketer who has scaled high-ticket service brands and coaches across India with profitable, predictable client acquisition funnels.

questions.q: Why is the audit priced at ₹21?
questions.a: ₹21 acts as a commitment filter to ensure only serious coaches book slots, saving time for both of us.

questions.q: Is this a group webinar or a 1:1 meeting?
questions.a: It is strictly a 100% private 1:1 strategy session with founder Nishant Bhutani on Google Meet.

questions.q: What language will the meeting be conducted in?
questions.a: We can conduct the meeting comfortably in Hindi, English, or Hinglish based on your preference.

questions.q: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
questions.a: You can reschedule up to 4 hours before the meeting via the link in your confirmation email.
Yes, if you feel the 45 minutes did not provide value, simply reply to the booking email and we will refund ₹21 immediately.

questions.q: Do I need to run ads before booking?
questions.a: No, whether you currently run ads or depend entirely on organic social media, this audit will pinpoint your exact expansion roadmap.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first, ultra-fast landing page targeting Indian relationship coaches charging ₹10,000+.
Implement the midnight IST countdown timer calculating remaining time till 23:59:59 IST daily.
Ensure all CTA buttons redirect to the Razorpay URL (pass dummy or real URL smoothly) and fire Meta Pixel click conversion event.
Add data-testid on every interactive button, input, accordion header, card, timer, and CTA link.
Ensure legal pages (Privacy, Terms, Cancellation, Contact) can be opened in smooth accessible dialog modals or tab views.
Keep mobile performance high, no unnecessary bloated external CSS, fast loading inline components.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
DO NOT use transparent background in header, sticky bars, or overlays.
Ensure high contrast WCAG standards for text over white or tinted backgrounds.
Strictly follow the light theme with crisp blue #2563EB accent colors.
